In detail

Residential hillside east of the centre, with the Parco di San Giovanni — the former asylum turned public park — at its heart. The review found no area-specific safety reporting for it: it is in none of the Prefettura's zone rosse, and not among the rioni named in the 2026 anti-degrado operations or the #RioniSicuri rounds. The dashed outline marks that as an absence of findings, not a verified all-clear.

Wandroz rates San Giovanni, Chiadino, Rozzol in Trieste as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Trieste. That rating rests on an area-level review that reached no traveller-relevant reporting specific to San Giovanni, Chiadino, Rozzol — no incidents, no recurring problems, nothing documented either way — read together with the character of the area.
